June 2025 is the most recent series AQA has published. AQA keeps each summer's papers for teachers only for about a year, so the data here runs to the latest public series. November 2020 and November 2021 were the autumn series sat in place of the cancelled summer exams.

June 2025 is the most recent series OCR has published. OCR keeps each summer's papers for teachers only for about a year, so the data here runs to the latest public series. November 2020 and November 2021 were the autumn series sat in place of the cancelled summer exams.

Papers 1 and 2 at A level are 85 marks each (60 marks of structured questions then 25 multiple-choice questions); Paper 3 is 80 marks: 45 on practical skills and data analysis and 35 on your option. AS Paper 1 is 70 marks of structured questions; AS Paper 2 is 40 marks of structured questions and 30 multiple-choice questions. The Practical Endorsement is reported separately and does not count towards the grade.

Papers 1 and 2 at A level are 100 marks each (15 multiple-choice questions then 85 marks of structured questions); Paper 3 is 70 marks of structured questions on all six modules. AS Paper 1 is 20 multiple-choice questions and 50 marks of structured questions; AS Paper 2 is 70 marks of structured questions. The practical endorsement is reported separately and does not count towards the grade.
The thin blocks at the end of Papers 1 and 2 (and AS Paper 2) are the multiple-choice questions of Section B; Paper 3 has none.
The thin blocks at the start of Papers 1 and 2 (and AS Paper 1) are the multiple-choice questions of Section A; Paper 3 and AS Paper 2 have none.
